verdicts.reason: The two are almost identical. Both stack a left-aligned headline (with 'Sunday' alone on the third line) over right-aligned event details, then the window, which sits jammed right under the details. That leaves about 130px of dead space at the bottom against a cramped middle, and the left/right alignment split has no shared axis. A is slightly worse: its headline sits about 12px from the left edge and its details about 8px from the right edge. B keeps a more even margin of about 20px on both sides.
